text:
maya: Heads up — customer reported a big vectors/sec drop on /v1/embeddings after the 03:05 deploy. tokens/sec looks steady, embeddings vectors/sec ~40% lower. ticket# A-183. Anyone on call? :eyes:

samir: seeing same in grafana for brightframe-prod. tokens_per_sec ~12k steady, vectors_per_sec from ~8k -> ~4.7k since 03:08. GPU util on pool-g1 jumped to 95% then dropped to 60% with queue growth.

eli: do we have any routing changes in the deploy? sounded like we enabled variant-routing fallback for quantized models.

maya: deploy notes: "enable variant routing for p-embed-small as fallback". I rolled that out to 10% at 03:00, 100% at 03:04.

ashley: quick sanity checks: model dims unchanged (1536). no auth/billing errors in ticket. no 4xx spikes.

ops-bot: metric alert: embeddings_queue_depth > 200 on pool-g1 at 03:12 (fired), recovery not yet observed.

samir: logs show many small requests being batched into larger windows after the routing change. batch_window_ms increased from 8 -> 22 for p-embed-small variant. That would increase single-request latency but reduce per-token cost; odd that vectors/sec dropped.

eli: could be KV cache behavior — quantized variant has different KV cache path causing heavier GPU memory pressure and slower kernel selection. kvcache hit rate for those requests dropped from 88% -> 46% at 03:06.

kvcache-bot: kvcache miss rate spike: 03:05-03:15, client_hash=brightframe-prod, affected_shards=[g1-03,g1-05].

maya: repro attempt — running local loadtest against /v1/embeddings with the same payloads and concurrency. small script: ```bash
seq 1 200 | xargs -n1 -P16 -I{} curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"p-embed-small","input":"quick test text"}' > /dev/null
```
Result: tokens/sec steady, vectors/sec ~45% lower when routing enabled.

eli: can you share the head of the server logs showing batch sizes and kernel choices?

maya: pasted snippets: ```
[03:06:12] batch_start size=48 window_ms=22 model=p-embed-small kernel=quant-kernel-v2 gpu=0
[03:06:12] kvcache miss client=brightframe prod_key=XXXX shard=g1-03
[03:06:12] gpu_exec latency=12ms tokens=640 vectors=48
[03:06:12] batch_end size=48 gpu_waiters=6 queue_depth=198
```

samir: kernel=quant-kernel-v2 shows slower per-token throughput on short sequences because reduced parallelism for int8 path. Combined with larger batch window the GPU is getting saturated with high-variance batch sizes -> queuing. That explains vectors/sec drop even when token/sec steady (tokenization differs).

ashley: interesting — token/sec steady because many tokens per request increased, but vectorization path slower due to quant-kernel memory layout. So vectors/sec (actual produced embedding vectors per second) drops.

maya: what mitigations?

eli: short-term: rollback variant-routing to previous default for brightframe-prod (pin to p-embed-base with float kernels). We can also force smaller batch_window for p-embed-small on that client via route override.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued: rollback p-embed-small variant-routing for brightframe-prod to 03:00 config. ETA ~8m.

maya: started rollback. also opened a canary to route 10% to float variant to confirm.

samir: additional measure: reduce max_batch_size for quant variant from 64 -> 32 to avoid GPU kernel thrash.

eli: long-term: tweak kernel selector to prefer float path for short sequences and small batch sizes; add a pre-check to route clients with high kvcache miss rate away from quant variant until cache warms.

maya: customer updated: "we see improvement after you flipped routing back, still monitoring". ticket owner thanks. :relieved:

ops-bot: alert cleared at 03:31, embeddings_queue_depth back to baseline.

ashley: write-up for postmortem: hypothesis is variant-routing -> quant kernel path -> increased KV misses -> GPU kernel inefficiency for short sequences -> queue growth -> vectors/sec regression. Include reproducer script and suggested config mitigations.

maya: I'll file an internal follow-up and attach logs + grafana panels. assigning to eng-runtime for kernel selector work.

eli: attaching dashboard link (private): https://grafana.internal/d/embeddings/vecs?orgId=1&from=now-2h to correlate.

maya: thanks all. closing thread once postmortem is up. :white_check_mark:
